content.title: Bhad Bhabie Says She Got ‘Bad News’ Related to Her Cancer
content.text: Photo: Paul Archuleta/FilmMagic Bhad Bhadie, real name Danielle Bregoli and better known as the “Cash me outside” teen from Dr. Phil, gave a brief update on her cancer diagnosis on February 28. “Bad news from my doctor yesterday, god has the last say so not my cancer,” she wrote on X. The controversial star first shared the news of her cancer diagnosis in November 2024, after fans commented on her alleged weight loss. “I’m sorry my cancer medicine made me loose weight,” she wrote at the time on Instagram Stories. “I’m slowly gaining back. So, stop running the worst narratives 💕.” Her mother also confirmed Bregoli’s diagnosis. Bregoli later shared that she has a type of blood cancer, as she has a high white blood-cell count. When some fans criticized her for getting two different cosmetic surgeries done, Bregoli stated she was cleared by her doctors to go through with the surgeries. Despite her health struggles, Bregoli continues her music career, including releasing a diss track against Alabama Barker called “Ms. Whitman.” The two began fighting online over Bregoli’s ex and the father of her child, Le Vaughn.
